query_coordinates: 0-based original-file byte offsets; identical 16384-byte requests for every row
latency: API-only: bgzf_useek + bgzf_read, ZSTD_seekable_decompress, or aceapex_decompress_region; excludes FASTA processing, return checks, verification, initialization, loading, caller allocation and serialization
archives: bgzip anonymous Linux memfd, .gzi loaded once; ACEAPEX and zstd malloc buffers
decoder_state: one initialized handle per codec, reused across warmup and all 200 queries
amplification: actual decoded chunk bytes / requested bytes; count BGZF block expansion, zstd block expansion inside frames including buffered output, and ACEAPEX chunks in all four streams

amplification_evidence.bgzip: inflate/libdeflate output counters in separate pass
amplification_evidence.zstd: actual decompressed block sizes at streaming and one-shot decode sites in a pinned-source counting copy
amplification_evidence.aceapex: actual selected raw chunk sizes, separately for literals/offsets/lengths/commands, in a pinned-source counting copy

gpu: n/a: no GPU adapter in stage 1

batch.H_alpha: Shannon entropy of request-start blocks using row block size
batch.hot_set: 64 unique canonical 16 KiB blocks selected once per run; identical raw-byte traces across codecs
batch.method: loop for all codecs; native batch additionally measured for both ACEAPEX profiles

break_even.meaning: derived independent-read intersection; not batch crossover; no plateau throughput claim
